title: Org unit
description: An org unit of the organisation: one the member directly belongs to, or the one a ship belongs to.

id.description: Opaque identifier issued by the Basetool. Clients store and echo it, never parse it.

kind.description: A squadron, a special command, an area or the organisation's leadership.

logistician.description: Only in the units of an org-stock page, and always there: whether the member is a Logistician of exactly this unit. With exchange.orgstock.write the member writes this unit's pool and reads its roster and targets; a unit with false answers those with 403 NOT_PERMITTED.
